title: Animated Form Fields
subtitle: Labels, hints and errors that hold a form's inputs together.

descriptions.labelStyle: Where the label sits: floats up on focus, inside and fades while typing, or above the field.
descriptions.showSuccessTick: Draws a tick in the field once its value is valid.
descriptions.showCounter: Shows a character counter on fields with a limit.
descriptions.showDescription: Shows a helper line under each field.
descriptions.validate: Checks required fields when you submit and shows errors for empty ones.
descriptions.errorAnimation: How the error message enters: slides open, fades in, or appears at once.
descriptions.shakeOnError: The field shakes when it shows an error.
